required_facts_checked: EC2 instance profiles attach a role and obtain temporary credentials through STS.
AWS tools read credentials from instance metadata and refresh them after expiry.
AWS_CONTAINER_CREDENTIALS_FULL_URI works as an endpoint outside EC2.
The Lambda returns credentials in the format expected by AWS SDKs.
Codespaces can use a configured dev container without a long-lived key.
The workshop uses a separate sandbox account and a secret check for a public endpoint.
Agents can use a separate sandbox account for experiments.
aws-sandbox-cli writes credentials into a project for about an hour.
CI/CD and human application are used for real infrastructure changes.
The access design must prevent any route to production.
unsupported_claims_removed: Removed any suggestion that temporary credentials are safe without role, endpoint and account controls.
substantive_edits: Rewrote the draft as a teaching explanation of the credential flow and its boundaries.
Separated workshop, agent, deployment and phone-gate uses.
Made sandboxing, expiration, revocation and production isolation explicit review criteria.
